edge_sample.source_text: definition Elementary Topos: An \emph{elementary topos} is a category $\mathcal{C}$ that \begin{enumerate} \item has chosen finite limits, \item is cartesian closed for the inherited chosen finite products, \item has a subobject classifier. \end{enumerate}
edge_sample.target_text: definition Natural Numbers Object: In a topos $\mathcal{C}$, a \emph{natural numbers object} is an object $N$ with morphisms $0 : 1 \to N$ and $s : N \to N$ satisfying the appropriate universal property.

edge_sample.source_text: definition Chosen Limits of Shape: A category $C$ has \emph{chosen limits of shape} $J$ if every functor $F : J \to C$ has a chosen limit.
edge_sample.target_text: definition Chosen Finite Limits: A category $C$ has \emph{chosen finite limits} if it has chosen limits of shape $J$ for every finite category $J$, i.~e.~ for every finite limit cone.

edge_sample.source_text: definition Chosen Finite Limits: A category $C$ has \emph{chosen finite limits} if it has chosen limits of shape $J$ for every finite category $J$, i.~e.~ for every finite limit cone.
edge_sample.target_text: lemma Chosen Finite Products from Limits: If a category $C$ has chosen finite limits, then it has chosen finite products.
